# Raed (رائد)

> An open Arabic edition of the CVE List. Every CVE record published by the CVE Program is read within the hour and shown in Arabic, with severity (CVSS), exploit probability (EPSS), CISA KEV status and the original English description unchanged.

- [Latest records](https://cve.3li.info/latest/): records published in the last 30 days, day by day
- [Record page](https://cve.3li.info/record/?id=CVE-2024-3094): any CVE ID, read live from the CVE Services API
- [Known exploited](https://cve.3li.info/kev/): the CISA KEV catalogue in Arabic
- [Weekly digest](https://cve.3li.info/week/): every Monday
- [Open data](https://cve.3li.info/data/): JSON files behind the site
- [Towards an Arab CNA](https://cve.3li.info/cna/join/): the path and the application kit
